recentItems.description:
Aishwarya Rai Bachchan’s daughter Aaradhya Bachchan has once again caught fans’ attention with a rare glimpse into her family life. The 14-year-old was seen celebrating Raksha Bandhan with her maternal cousins, Vihaan and Shivansh Rai. Naturally, the actor’s absence has left fans wondering where he was and why he did not appear in the pictures.
